notes: Synthetic engineering only: replay the frozen source score trace with two policies (fixed and hysteresis) at one setting each, no sweep. High is the frozen source calibration threshold; low is 0.8*high. Initial latch is normal; ties hold (strict comparisons); each replay resets to normal independently. Episode-rate tolerance (<=250 per 1000 decisions, label-free) and coverage floor (1.0) are reporting criteria recorded per policy as feasible plus reasons, not rejection gates: infeasible rows are preserved with actual rate and coverage. No quality selection and no recall targets. Not an authoritative operating record. Future source reuse is not real-data support; absent a manifest/reservation there is no real data.
